neighbours.label: the complement slot right after a fear word: 'of' (and what follows) after fear, afraid, scared, fearful, terrified
fire: Her fear of heights kept her off the ladder.

The town lived in fear of another flood.

The rabbit's knowledge of the field kept it safe.
